title: The fixed module/Ext resolution comparison respects arbitrary h-maps
statement: For arbitrary schemes X,Y, g:Y to X, modules F on X and G on Y, a coefficient map phi:F to g_*G, degree q and module-cohomology element x, the fixed moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv carries moduleCohomologyFMap(g,phi,q)(x) to the small-universe abelian Ext h-map: inverse image by invImage(g), precomposition with constIso(g).symm, and postcomposition with coeff(g,phi). This involves only [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality], [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] and [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], without any change of Ext universe.

proof.text: Apply moduleCohomology_transport_coefficient to the fixed resolution equivalence on both schemes. Supply moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv_naturality for the given coefficient map and moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv_edge for its target module. This yields the small-Ext h-map equality directly.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv_hmap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward g).obj G)
    (q : ℕ) (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F) :
    moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv Y G q (moduleCohomologyFMap g φ q x) =
      Sheaf.H.map (coeff g φ) q
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) q
          (moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv X F q x))
